analyticsEvents.routeSelectRule: fires only when the visitor actually supplies channel context
analyticsEvents.renameRule: There is no online checkout. A submitted request is not a purchase, payment or conversion to a paying customer.

assets.rule: use as is, no regeneration, no renaming, no stock substitutes, text stays real HTML

hardRules: no overclaim that a public scan found the root cause
public scan never blocks the purchase
crawler-visible and user-visible content stay identical
WCAG AA, visible focus, keyboard operable disclosure controls
no weakening of URL fetch protections or rate limiting

faq.master: comprehensive, includes the Claude / AI objection question
faq.paid: 8 paid-specific questions, visible text and FAQPage schema identical, master FAQ is not appended

development.default: NODE_ENV !== production: no lead write, no mail, route answers ok with devSuppressed:true
